subject: How to disable any UI components while data is being loaded on server. R

messages.author: 3a883866e91137c8
messages.subject: How to disable any UI components while data is being loaded on server. R
parts:
Hello

I have an app which loads a large data set from database and then provides certain options for the users to see the graphs of various parts of the data set. Is there a way to disable all UI elements when the data is being loaded in server. Some thing like an hourglass or some rotating icon display while server is loading will be helpful. Appreciate any hints,

Bhaskar
